dedupe_keys.name: synthsom multimodal sensing and communication scenarios

description: SynthSoM publishes simulated sensing and radio-communication observations from five air-ground and road scenarios. The research team combines AirSim, WaveFarer and Wireless InSite outputs for urban crossroads, wide roads, an overpass, a suburban fork and a mountain road. The files contain camera and depth observations, LiDAR and radar information, channel matrices and path loss under different traffic, weather and lighting conditions. Figshare supplies five large 7z packages under CC BY 4.0 at no charge. The companion repository documents coordinate systems, sensor geometry and helper code. In the urban-crossroad scenario, adjacent snapshots are 50 milliseconds apart; MAT channel files and TXT point-cloud files share snapshot identifiers. Coverage is synthetic scenes, not measured geographic locations or calendar periods. The data can test cooperative sensing, radio prediction and vehicle-infrastructure observation models alongside model-sumo and model-vienna-5g-simulators. The release does not prove transfer to real streets or make the source simulation engines freely licensed. Ground-vehicle trajectory heights require the documented coordinate correction before sensors are combined.
